text: Very useful app for organizing your skincare routine, analyzing ingredients, trying new products, and tracking skin condition. You can add products that are not in the database. A must-have for people with hundreds of bottles and true skincare enthusiasts.
author: Olga Trayzhon
developer_reply: Thank you, happy to hear you find the app helpful!
